title: Knoepp Carriage House | Vacation Rental Rosemary Beach FL | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: This 1-bedroom vacation rental Rosemary Beach FL is a lovely and quaint place to stay with a wrap-around balcony that looks out over the waves. Book today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to Knoepp Carriage House!

When you walk through the door, you'll find an open floor plan which gives the home an open spacious feel. Relax in a quiet little sitting area that includes a queen-sized sleeper should you wish to house an additional guest or two who are lucky enough to join you. In front of the open kitchen, you will find a unique stone dining table, complete with stone countertops and cherry wood cabinets. Against the far wall, you'll find the entrance to the cozy bedroom, complete with a double bed. As you come back to the main room, you might enjoy taking a step onto the war-around balcony that offers breathtaking views of the gulf.

Garage access.

**No Internet/Wifi provided**

This property requires a 4 night minimum stay during spring break and summer and a 2 night minimum stay during shoulder season
